…all persons that have lived upon the earth shall appear before the tribunal of Christ, to give an account of their thoughts, words, and deeds, and to receive according to what they have done in the body, whether good or evil
As Christ would have us to be certainly persuaded that there shall be a day of judgment, both to deter all men from sin
Christ, as our Redeemer, executes the offices of a prophet, of a priest, and of a king, both in His estate of humiliation and exaltation
and accepts us as righteous in His sight
with full purpose of, and endeavor after, new obedience
of their faith to feed upon Him
